text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v3.12.0 (canary -> 5% traffic) in change window 03/23 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary hosts: eu-west-1. Rollout plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 10m observation. Rollback criteria: sustained p95 latency > 800ms for 5m OR error rate > 1.5% for 3m. 
Alex: noted. tagging QA to watch the new tokenization path.
Maria: +1 watching observability. posting dashboard link: https://grafana.local/d/rls/throughput-latency
Sam: quick heads up — on-call saw a small tail at 02:07 in EU but it recovered. no action then.
Leo: I'm on watch, will call hold if p95 climbs past 700ms for 3m.
Alex: ops checklist: pin hotfix branch v3.12.0-hotpatch ready if we need immediate rollback.
Maria: seeing a small spike now, p95 -> 720ms, error 0.6%
Sam: can we reduce step to 10% instead of 20% if it keeps drifting?
Alex: we can. change request: next step = 10% for 10m, then 25% if stable.
deploy-bot: change accepted by release owner Alex. Updated rollout: 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50%.
Maria: telemetry note: KV cache evictions in canary logs, correlating with requests for long sequences.
Leo: if evictions persist, fallback policy is to pin model to quantized variant q8 that has smaller KV footprint.
Sam: do we want to pre-stage that variant in dedicated pool? pre-warm might save time.
Alex: yes, pre-stage q8 in eu-west-1 standby. ops, can you spin it up?
Sam: on it. running: `infra run --env eu-west-1 --image model-q8 --count 2`
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 02:12 UTC. Observing metrics.
Maria: p95 back down to 650ms. errors stable at 0.5%. good so far.
Leo: still seeing intermittent evictions but not sustained. hold off on rollback.
Alex: OK. Proceed with 10% step in 3m unless new signal.
deploy-bot: Scheduled step: increase to 10% at 02:16 UTC.
Maria: at 02:15 I'm seeing a sudden 5xx burst from one node: 0.9% across canary, upstream connection resets.
Sam: isolating node 3 in the canary pool. removing from LB.
Alex: call for stop/go: Do we pause? I'm inclined to pause and investigate quick. thoughts?
Leo: vote: pause. we need to confirm it's infra vs app.
Maria: vote: pause. requests show `tcp_reset` in node's logs. could be infra.
Sam: paused the step. draining traffic from node 3.
deploy-bot: Rollout step paused by Sam at 02:18 UTC — reason: 5xx burst from canary node.
Alex: decision: hold on further percent increases. Do not rollback yet. Pin current rollout to v3.12.0 at 5% until node health confirmed.
Maria: filing post in incident channel with traces and logs.
Sam: infra team will run `sudo systemctl restart network-agent` and monitor.
Leo: if node returns clean in 10m, we can resume to 10%. if not, remove node and resume.
Alex: prepare release notes update: add note about KV cache behavior and temporary hold.
Maria: adding note now: "Canary paused due to transient infra 5xx from one EU canary host. No user-impacting rollback. Monitoring continues."
deploy-bot: Canary node removed from rotation at 02:22 UTC. Canary traffic remains at 5%.
Sam: node replaced with standby q8-prestage instance as a test; health checks passing.
Leo: p95 remains ~640ms after replacement. good.
Alex: consensus: resume to 10% at 02:30 if metrics stable for next 6m. otherwise maintain hold.
Maria: agreed. updating ticket and release changelog.
Sam: FYI execs informed via email digest.
deploy-bot: Scheduled resume for next step at 02:30 UTC (manual confirm required).
Alex: will confirm at 02:30. ping me then.
Maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
